From Stone Free · Price: your body becomes the string, so damage to the string is damage to you.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: Your body unravels: reach 15 ft for Interact and Grapple, and you can squeeze through any gap.
  • 5: 1 action: string trap in a 10-ft area: first creature in it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed} (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates).
  • 9: Surge: string net, @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-ft burst}: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained} for 1 round (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates).
  • 13: String reach 30 ft.
  • 17: You can sew wounds closed: allies heal @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[healing]] each turn while touched (once per round, max 1 minute).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
